# Geocradle

Soil spectral library from the Geocradle region (Balkans, Middle East, and North Africa)

## Overview

- **Sample size:** 1,000+
- **Version:** first release (v1)
- **Spectral range:** vnir
- **Extent:** regional

- **n properties available:** 18
- **n properties standardized:** 7
- **n properties harmonized:** pending
- **properties themes:** physical, chemical, carbon & nutrients

## Soil site information

- **coordinates precision:** precise, country
- **sampling depth:** various
- **geography:** soil taxonomy, elevation
